purpose: Genuine adapter supervised fine-tuning of a general causal LLM on immediate board facts; measure a narrowly defined learned task on a new game-disjoint cohort.
excluded_comparisons: Not a matched comparison with the27b representation diagnostic, Stockfish move experiments, rollout stress tests or video scenes.
No strategic commentary, general chess understanding, move strength, Elo, sports transfer, statistical significance or automatic promotion claim.
pre_execution_gates: Root freezes reviewed protocol before selection.
Root independently reviews intake/source/tests and frozen dataset/token boundaries before any pretrained forward or GPU run.
A separate source-bound resource/ownership preflight and native worker supervisor must pass before loading weights. No implicit authorization arises from this proposal.

model.runtime_tie_gate: After actual local from_pretrained, require input embedding weight is output head weight,596049920 unique base parameters, correct config and frozen BF16 base. Meta inspection alone is not runtime verification. Fail on mismatch before forward.

acquisition.failed_reason: Original32MiB CSV acquisition failed certificate validation; no TLS bypass.
acquisition.scope: One complete pinned Parquet shard only; not the full884570255byte dataset. Footer shows2052447rows/5rowgroups; no cohort row has been selected in this proposal.

intake.read: Sequential ParquetFile.iter_batches(batch_size4096,columnsPuzzleId/GameId/FEN/Moves,use_threadsFalse), physical rowgroup and row order. GameId is the native string field; no GameUrl column exists.
intake.game_identity: Full-match native GameId against ([A-Za-z0-9]{8})(?:/(?:white|black))?(?:#[0-9]+)? and use group1 as the case-sensitive canonical game ID. Retain original field. Colour/ply suffix never participates in split or uniqueness. Reject malformed fields; never infer missing identity.
intake.source_replay: Validate orthodox Board(FEN) and replay ONLY first token of Moves as a legal setup move. Do not consume answer tail, rating, themes, openings or popularity. Setup-after board must be valid, nonterminal and have legal moves.
intake.game_split: int.from_bytes(sha256(utf8(str(seed)+":"+game_id)),big)%10;0..7train,8dev,9holdout. First eligible source-order rows until every quota fills; no quota/sample substitution after outcomes.
intake.chosen_legal_move: Sort setup-after legal UCI strings lexicographically; index=int.from_bytes(sha256(utf8("move:4082031:"+game_id)),big)%legal_count. Independent move hash; no teacher/source-answer choice.
intake.board_key: Canonical python-chess Board.fen() first4fields, including legal en-passant representation; omit half/fullmove clocks for deduplication. Preserve full FEN in model inputs.

prior_exclusions.reconstruct: Reconstruct all historical+v1/v2/v3/v4 source-before and setup-after board roles from the retained4MiB source prefix and manifests; do not rely solely on previously derived counts.
prior_exclusions.additional_spent: Add all16 spent board-fact games and both roles. Replay all64 rollout PGNs including initial board and every state. Add all3 illustrative video FEN keys. Report deduplicated unions/counts/hashes rather than presume additive counts.
prior_exclusions.new_disjointness: For every accepted row exclude its game and both source-before/setup-after keys globally across all new splits; one accepted position per game. Rejections and scanned row order/count must be retained.
prior_exclusions.other_prior_work: Before freeze compare the project experiment/dataset inventory with this exact list; any newly discovered spent holdout/cohort requires an explicit source-bound protocol amendment before selection.

intake.no_rebalancing: Report natural field/positive special-move coverage; do not select extra castling/en-passant/promotion examples or replace cases. Fail if the pinned shard cannot fill quotas.

inputs.representation: FEN + selected legal UCI + full64-square PRE-move coordinate piece map only.

labels.truth: Eight exact immediate facts via existing two independent Python routes: predicates and board-push/material/geometry/king-attacks; retain manual special-move fixtures.
labels.storage: Input-only train/dev/holdout files, separate per-split labels, immutable manifest and dataset/source hashes. Training opens train labels only; generation opens inputs only. Labels stay outside every model request.
labels.canonical_target: json.dumps(facts,sort_keysTrue,separators(",",":")) followed by native assistant EOS only; no explanation or reasoning content.
labels.class_metrics: Report all field class counts per split before results. Report capture/check/castling/en-passant true counts and promotion classes; no claim from absent positive classes.

tokenization.tokenizer: Pinned local native tokenizer with enable_thinkingFalse; no remote code. Current classQwen2Tokenizer, pad151643,eos151645.
tokenization.native_prefix: Render user-only prompt with add_generation_promptTrue,enable_thinkingFalse. Render joint user+assistant compactJSON with add_generation_promptFalse,enable_thinkingFalse; require exact jointIDs[:prefixLen]==prefixIDs for EVERY selected train/dev target.
tokenization.target_boundary: Within the joint IDs, locate the FIRST eos_token_id AFTER the verified assistant generation-prefix boundary. Retain through that EOS inclusive; omit ONLY native post-EOS newline. Do not search the first EOS in the entire chat, because the user turn already has an EOS.
tokenization.mask: All generation-prefix tokens and all padding labels=-100; supervise exactly JSON tokens plus assistant EOS. No concatenation of independently encoded prompt/target token lists.
tokenization.training_padding: LEFT-pad input IDs with151643 and attention_mask0; left-pad labels-100. Derive position_ids=(attention_mask.cumsum(-1)-1).masked_fill(mask==0,0). No packed examples.
tokenization.boundary_gate: Before any pretrained forward, all frozen training/dev rows must pass native prefix, EOS, target mask/count and length checks. Holdout input-only token lengths checked; holdout target validation belongs to separate frozen intake/evaluator audit, never the generation loader.
tokenization.failure: Fail the experiment on any out-of-contract frozen row; no silent truncation, dropping, replacement or automatic fallback.

training.ordering: One torch.randperm8192 using a dedicated CPU Generator seeded4082031, hashed before training. Consume each example exactly once in consecutive batches8; no reshuffle or adaptive sampling.

lora.init: Standard PEFT A Kaiming-uniform, B zero; exact installed default source bound.
lora.runtime_checks: Verify exact target names/shapes/counts, trainable dtype/count and no unintended trainable base/head/embedding parameters.

loss_optimization.labels_argument: labels[:,-128:] on left-padded full input sequence; model still attends to full pre-move prompt.
loss_optimization.precondition: For each row T(supervisedJSON+EOS)+1<=128; all labels before the supervised target and all padding are-100; native prefix exact. Every target prediction and its preceding hidden state then lie inside the last128 window.
loss_optimization.loss: Installed ForCausalLMLoss on cropped logits/labels performs causal shift and mean over all nonignored target tokens in the actual batch8.
loss_optimization.why: Bounds vocab logits to8Ã—128Ã—151936 instead of8Ã—1536Ã—151936. About0.290GiB BF16 logits plus0.580GiB FP32 loss view, excluding other allocations. This is an estimate, not a measured resource guarantee.
loss_optimization.source_gate: Hash and review installed Qwen3 forward and causal loss source; fail on drift.
loss_optimization.no_runtime_fallback: Fixed cropped actualbatch8 policy. If unsupported, stop; effectivebatch8 via micro1Ã—8 token-weighted accumulation is a separately reviewed alternative requiring a pre-run protocol amendment, not an automatic switch.

training.scheduler: For update indexu=0..1023, LR=2e-4*min(1,(u+1)/32), applied before that optimizer step. FirstLR6.25e-6; update32andlater2e-4. Exactly one optimizer/scheduler step per batch8.
training.checks: Retain every update loss/target counts/LR/finite gradient norms/completed steps. First meaningful LoRA B gradients must be finite/nonzero; initial A zero gradients are expected with Bzero. Hash frozen base before/after. A tiny random CPU test already verifies base equivalence/gradients, but real run checks remain required.
training.retention: Save immutable adapters/config, optimizer/scheduler/RNG state and permutation/source bindings at checkpoints; step0 is original base with adapter explicitly disabled. Negative/aborted checkpoints remain evidence, never automatically promoted.

dev.step0: Use disable_adapter context on the same loaded frozen base. Record adapter-disabled state explicitly.
dev.raw_first: Generate all128 raw token sequences/text/statuses at each checkpoint, save and hash seal before opening dev labels. Failed/truncated/not-run rows stay in all128 denominator.

evaluation.selection: After all predeclared dev checkpoints, select maximum all-eight-correct count, then maximum strict-parse-completed count, then earliest step. Persist complete ranking, checkpoint hashes and selection BEFORE any heldout model calls or heldout label join.

holdout.no_tuning: Only these two preselected conditions, once each. If step0 wins, selected condition also uses adapter-disabled base; do not silently reuse/deduplicate results or pick a different checkpoint.
holdout.raw_first: Each full256-outcome raw condition is sealed before heldout labels are loaded. No other checkpoint tested on holdout; no repeated calls or repairs.

generation.no_constraints: No legal mask, JSON repair or constrained grammar; same predeclared native prompt for base and adapter.
generation.decode: Separate new IDs at padded input width; keep raw IDs. First generated native EOS terminates output. Decode preceding IDs with skip_special_tokensFalse; remove only generated batch padding after EOS. No think/fence/prose extraction. Missing EOS at cap is truncation.

metrics.primary: All8 exact facts correct and strict completed JSON, out of full planned denominator.
metrics.fields: Exact typed correctness,unknown/abstention,parse/truncation/error/not-run counts per field/full denominator.
metrics.positive_classes: Report per-class support and correctness for moving/captured/promoted pieces and colours; positive true-class counts/correctness for capture/check/castling/en-passant. Include confusion counts. If positive support0, report not assessed, not perfect skill.
metrics.no_selective_credit: Malformed/truncated/error/not-run outputs receive zero field correctness; no partial-field rescue. unknown gets no correctness credit.

evaluation.failures: No retries/response repair. On resource/transport/runtime failure stop owned work, retain every preplanned remaining row as not_run. An incomplete experiment is not a completed paired result; do not select/promote from incomplete planned checkpoints.

resources.start: Before weight load require empty Ollama /api/ps/no foreign llama-server, exclusive root GPU handoff and10healthy nominal1s samples: physical>=10GiB,commitheadroom>=16GiB,GPUfree>=13GiB.
resources.during: Background sampler starts BEFORE weight load and continues through training/dev/holdout/save/cleanup. Record physical,commit andGPU metrics at nominal1s interval; gap>3s,missing/nonfinite counter,physical<4GiB,commitheadroom<8GiB orGPUfree<1GiB latches stop.
resources.stop: Background reserve/counter/deadline failure latches stop. A generation StoppingCriteria stops the current owned generation at the next available token boundary; training stops before any further forward/backward/optimizer/checkpoint operation at its next safe boundary. Preserve partial raw IDs, current attempted/completed update counts and all remaining planned not_run outcomes; save aborted metadata best effort, release only own model/optimizer/CUDA references and exit. In-flight kernels may finish before a safe boundary; this is not an instantaneous allocation-peak guarantee.
resources.owned_supervision: A parent monitor owns exactly the subprocess.Popen child handle created for this run, records PID and command/source hashes, and starts monitoring before weight load. A latched failure creates a cancel marker; the worker checks it before/after steps/checkpoints and via generation StoppingCriteria. If still alive30seconds after cancellation, terminate only that exact Popen child handle; never enumerate/kill by name, kill unrelated processes, alter global settings or close user apps. Retain forced termination and partial-progress evidence; no retry.
resources.memory_estimates: LoRA has5,046,272 F32 parameters; frozen tied base596,049,920 BF16 unique parameters after actual verification. Record measured peaks, CUDA allocated/reserved and hostcommit; parameter counts alone do not bound activation/logit/workspace memory.
resources.no_policy_relaxation: Do not lower reserves, change batches, alter precision, drop samples or repeat a failed job without a new reviewed amendment.
resources.phase_wall_scope: Training/dev timer starts before native model load and covers all1024 updates, every predeclared dev generation/evaluation and persisted selection. Only after complete dev selection is sealed may the separately bounded holdout phase start; its1800second timer covers base+selected512planned heldout generations, evaluator joins and finalization. Background monitoring and owned-process identity continue across phases. Failure/deadline in training/dev prevents holdout calls; no resume/retry.
